reason: Concrete long-side MA timing rules on daily bars for 30 US sector ETFs that can be approximated with trend_ma template.

universe.description: 30 sector ETFs covering most of the S&P 500

setup.rule: Trade 30 sector ETFs with upward bias via asymmetric MAs
setup.quote: when I'm trading my 30 sector ETFs which range across almost all the sectors and the markets the reason I do that is using 21 for the upside and 50 for the downside puts a slant towards the upside

entry.rule: Go long ETFs on 21-day MA upside signal
entry.quote: using 21 for the upside and 50 for the downside

stop.rule: Exit long ETFs or initiate hedge on 50-day MA downside cross
stop.quote: 50-day to initiate a hedge ... I do the same thing the other way with my long ETF

exits.rule: Exit to cash or hedge when 50-day MA signals downtrend

sizing.rule: Volatility-based position sizing across strategies to balance risk
sizing.quote: I set my risk uh in volatility control schemes on my position sizing

market_filter.rule: Hedge with single S&P futures when equity exposure needs protection
market_filter.quote: if I use an S&P futures hedge

ambiguities.issue: Exact MA crossover direction and confirmation not verbatim
ambiguities.assumption: Standard MA cross up on 21-day for entry, cross down on 50-day for exit/hedge
